stories.title: Calibre 2550, un concentré d’ingéniosité signé Vacheron Constantin

en.title: Calibre 2550, a concentration of ingenuity signed by Vacheron Constantin
en.summary: Vacheron Constantin has developed the calibre 2550, an automatic movement measuring 2.4mm thick with 80 hours of power reserve after seven years of research. The achievement demonstrates how reduced thickness can enhance mechanical performance rather than compromise it.

stories.title: F-35-Debakel – der Mann, der alles wusste

en.title: F-35 debacle – the man who knew everything
en.summary: Swiss defence officials believed in fixed prices for an F-35 acquisition despite contradictory evidence, with project leader Darko Savic holding sole knowledge of the details.

stories.title: Unfallursache wird untersucht – Regionalzug in Frankreich entgleist – 44 Verletzte

en.title: Cause of accident under investigation – regional train derails in France – 44 injured
en.summary: A regional train derailed in Normandy, France, resulting in dozens of people being injured. Authorities are investigating the cause of the accident.

stories.title: KOMMENTAR - KI ermöglicht noch nie gesehene Massenüberwachung. Unternehmen müssen aufhören, Standortdaten zu verkaufen

en.title: COMMENTARY - AI enables mass surveillance never before seen. Companies must stop selling location data
en.summary: Data brokers collect information on millions of people, and artificial intelligence makes their business increasingly dangerous by enabling automated tracking of ordinary citizens at scale.

en.summary: An overview of key artificial intelligence terminology from A to Z as AI technology spreads globally.

stories.title: «On est les ouvriers des algos»: derrière les paillettes, la santé mentale des influenceurs en danger

en.title: "We are the workers of algorithms": behind the glitter, influencers' mental health in danger
en.summary: Influencers describe experiencing exploitation through algorithm dependency, online harassment, and unstable work-life balance that pressures constant content creation and monetization of daily life.

stories.title: DATENANALYSE - Fünf Personen kamen beim Unfall im Engadin ums Leben. Wie gefährlich sind Carreisen?

en.title: DATA ANALYSIS - Five people died in the Engadin accident. How dangerous are coach trips?
en.summary: A graphical analysis examines the safety risks associated with coach travel following a fatal accident in the Engadin region.

stories.title: INTERVIEW - «Die AfD hat als einzige Partei auf positive Weise auf das ostdeutsche Lebensgefühl gesetzt»

en.title: INTERVIEW - "The AfD is the only party to positively address East German sentiment"
en.summary: Historian Katja Hoyer attributes the AfD's electoral success in Saxony-Anhalt to addressing regional perspectives rather than democratic deficits, noting that political and media dismissiveness proves counterproductive.

stories.title: L'emploi de la croix suisse sur des produits fabriqués à l'étranger divise le Parlement

en.title: Use of Swiss cross on foreign-made products divides Parliament
en.summary: The practice of marking products with the Swiss cross is generating criticism across multiple parliamentary groups. The Federal Council is not currently seeking to change the law but intends to review provisions related to "Swissness" standards.

stories.title: Un quart de siècle après, New York pleure ses morts victimes des attaques du 11 septembre

en.title: A quarter century later, New York mourns victims of September 11 attacks
en.summary: New York paid tribute Friday to victims of the September 11 attacks, which occurred 25 years ago. President Donald Trump chose to visit the Pentagon, which was also targeted in the terrorist attacks.

stories.title: L'inclusion automatique de la Suisse au «Made in Europe» divise le Parlement européen et la Commission

en.title: Automatic inclusion of Switzerland in "Made in Europe" divides European Parliament and Commission
en.summary: Debates in Brussels concern whether third countries like Switzerland should automatically qualify for certain EU public procurement contracts. European Parliament rapporteurs oppose automatic access, while the European Commission takes a different position.

stories.title: Vingt-cinq ans après le 11 Septembre, le maire de New York, Zohran Mamdani, panse les plaies des musulmans

en.title: Twenty-five years after September 11, New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani heals Muslim wounds
en.summary: New York's Muslim mayor, elected as a Democrat, represents healing in the city that experienced anti-Muslim backlash following the 2001 attacks. His leadership reflects years of activism and community progress across the diverse population.

en.summary: Swiss exporters view trade with South America as important, and a compromise proposal aims to secure Mercosur agreement approval in the upper house, though no party is fully satisfied.

stories.title: «Die Luft ist sicher», hiess es eine Woche nach 9/11 in New York. Heute sind Tausende krank

en.title: "The air is safe," officials said one week after 9/11 in New York. Today thousands are sick
en.summary: Newly released documents reveal how New York handled toxic dust from the World Trade Center collapse, with health consequences and official responsibility remaining disputed decades later.

stories.title: Türkisches Engagement in Somalia: Mogadiscio ermöglicht Ankara den Bau eines eigenen Weltraumbahnhofs

en.title: Turkish Engagement in Somalia: Mogadishu Permits Ankara to Build its Own Space Port
en.summary: Turkey, serving as Somalia's primary security guarantor, is expanding its strategic presence in the country by constructing a space port, thereby increasing its geopolitical influence in the region.
